items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Now Monty Kaye and Pete Gallaran and the other partner, they used to promote jam sessions on Sundays at Kelley's Stables.

ctx.x: One night, on my off night, on Monday night we had a jam session down in the Village VANGUARD And I had just flown in from Chicago. I went to Chicago to get some grass. Had ten pounds of grass in a paper bag sitting inside my porkpie hat on the table. Everybody thought it was my lunch. (Laughter). Well, the most obvious place is that you see it, you know it. If you hide it, someone is going to wonder what you are hiding. No one bothered it.

Now Monty Kaye and Pete Gallaran and the other partner, they used to promote jam sessions on Sundays at Kelley's Stables. They were there. So we -- You've been in the Vanguard, haven't you. You know how you step down the steps going out on the further side of the wall. You come down and walk a step

down the step. I was going to go down the steps and Leonard was coming up the steps. And I grabbed him by his arm. I say Hey man, I say when are you going to be giving me my money? He say what do you mean, I don't owe you any money. And if you want to make an ass of yourself, you do it at someone else's expense and take your hands off of me you jerk.
